prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Labour Party Manifesto 2024 — Summary (≤500 words)

Vision and approach
- “Time for change”: end Conservative “chaos,” restore stability, rebuild a country that serves working people.
- Mission-driven government with five long-term goals: highest sustained G7 growth; clean power by 2030; halve serious violent crime; break barriers to opportunity; build an NHS fit for the future.
- Fully costed within strict fiscal rules: balance the current budget and have debt falling by year five; no rises in National Insurance, basic/higher/additional Income Tax rates or VAT; clamp down on avoidance and non-dom status.

First steps
- Economic stability and OBR oversight.
- 40,000 extra NHS appointments per week using evening/weekend sessions.
- New Border Security Command; end Rwanda scheme; clear asylum backlog and hotels.
- Great British Energy (publicly owned) to cut bills, boost security.
- Crack down on antisocial behaviour; more neighbourhood police.
- 6,500 new teachers in key subjects.

Strong foundations
- National security: unshakeable NATO and nuclear deterrent; Strategic Defence Review; path to 2.5% GDP on defence; counter state threats, cyber and extremism.
- Secure borders: specialist investigators, EU security cooperation, faster returns.

Kickstarting growth
- Pro-business, pro-worker “securonomics” and industrial strategy with a statutory Industrial Strategy Council.
- National Wealth Fund (£7.3bn) to crowd in private capital: ports, gigafactories, steel, CCUS, green hydrogen.
- Tax certainty: cap corporation tax at 25% for the Parliament; permanent full expensing; replace business rates; one major fiscal event a year.
- 10-year infrastructure strategy; new National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority; planning reform for labs, grid, gigafactories; gigabit and 5G nationwide by 2030.
- Transport: maintain/renew roads; 1m extra potholes fixed annually; EV charging rollout, 2030 ICE phase-out restored; rail brought into public ownership as contracts expire via Great British Railways; bus franchising and municipal ownership enabled.
- Housing: 1.5m homes over the Parliament; restore targets; brownfield-first plus strategic “grey belt”; new towns; more social/affordable homes; first-time buyer mortgage guarantee; curb bulk sales to overseas investors.
- Work and skills: New Deal for Working People (ban exploitative zero-hours, end fire-and-rehire, day-one rights, Single Enforcement Body); real living wage with no lower age bands; support small business; reduce net migration linked to workforce plans; reformed employment support and youth guarantee.

Clean energy and nature
- Clean power by 2030: double onshore wind, triple solar, quadruple offshore wind; storage, CCUS, hydrogen, marine; extend nuclear (Hinkley, Sizewell C, SMRs); no new North Sea exploration licences; tougher windfall tax.
- Great British Energy capitalised with £8.3bn; Local Power Plan; British Jobs Bonus.
- Warm Homes Plan: £6.6bn to upgrade 5m homes; renters’ efficiency standards by 2030.
- Nature and water: enforce on polluting water firms; expand habitats; back British farmers; stronger animal welfare.

Safety and justice
- Neighbourhood Policing Guarantee; Respect Orders; shopworker protection; knife crime plan (bans, mandatory interventions); Young Futures hubs.
- Halve violence against women and girls: specialist police units and courts; stronger stalking/spiking laws; policing standards overhaul; faster justice; new prisons and reoffending reduction; Hillsborough Law; address historic injustices.

Opportunity, families, education
- Free primary school breakfast clubs; 3,000 school-based nurseries; review parental leave.
- 6,500 new teachers; curriculum/assessment reform; leadership support; improved inspections; mental health staff in every school; Skills England; Technical Excellence Colleges; flexible Growth and Skills Levy; sustainable HE reform.
- Renters’ rights: end Section 21; regulate standards; leasehold reform and end “fleecehold”; homelessness strategy.
- Equality: socio-economic duty; Race Equality Act; disability/ethnicity pay gap reporting; ban conversion practices; modernise gender recognition while upholding single-sex protections.
- Pensions: retain triple lock; strengthen workplace pensions.

NHS and care
- 2m extra annual operations/scans/appointments; use independent capacity; long-term workforce plan; double CT/MRI scanners; New Hospitals Programme; NHS innovation/adoption strategy; upgraded app and patient power; maternity safety.
- Primary/community shift: more GPs, face-to-face guarantee, family doctor continuity, pharmacist prescribing, neighbourhood health centres.
- Dentistry Rescue Plan: 700k urgent appointments; contract reform; tooth-brushing scheme.
- National Care Service with national standards; Fair Pay Agreement in adult social care.
- Mental health: 8,500 extra staff; Young Futures hubs; modernised Mental Health Act.
- Public health: smoke-free generation; restrict youth-targeted vapes; junk food ad ban to children; energy drinks under-16 ban; online safety; reduce gambling harm; tackle health inequalities and women’s health; end new HIV by 2030.

Cleaning up politics and UK abroad
- Ethics and Integrity Commission; ban MPs’ paid advisory roles; Commons modernisation.
- Lords reform: end hereditary peers; retirement at 80; plan for replacement second chamber.
- Votes at 16; fairer voter ID; party finance transparency; respectful devolution reset; Council of the Nations and Regions.
- Foreign policy: strong NATO, Ukraine support, AUKUS; defence industrial strategy; China realism; improved EU ties (no SM/CU/FoM), veterinary and security pacts; targeted trade deals; Clean Power Alliance; rebuild development leadership and aim to restore 0.7% when affordable.
